web_events.answer: China's August economic data indicates mixed results. The official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) held at 49.0, below the 50 threshold indicating expansion, while the HSBC Flash China Manufacturing PMI reached a four-month high at 50.6. Industrial output rose 5.2% year-over-year, up from 4.5% in July, but retail sales only grew by 0.4%, down from 0.6% in July.
